notes: Reached by direct fetch (no proxy needed). Site is on the Kartmax platform; /en-ae/ 301-redirects to the bare path, so canonical category URLs are https://www.theone.com/category/<slug> and already serve the English UAE catalogue (the PLP request the page itself issues carries country=en-ae). The listing header (#km-plp-count, label ' Items') is filled client-side from result.count of the page's own request to engine.kartmax.in/api/fast/search/v1/<md5(theone.com)>/plp-special. Per Rule 1 the API number was NOT trusted on its own: for every one of the 16 leaf rows the grid was paged to exhaustion and the unique product_id total matched result.count exactly (16/16), with the following page returning zero tiles. The request string was copied verbatim from each category page's own inline script, so it reproduces the shopper-visible population (in-stock, en-ae). Children also sum to their parents: Wall Art 70+12=82, Vases & Planters 33+17=50, Candles & Home Fragrances 66+61+50+29=206, Decorative Accents 10+24+2+15=51, Tableware 40+38+33+6=117. Excluded per brief: Rugs, Cushions & Throws, Table Linen, Kitchenware/Cookware, Cutlery, Bar Accessories, Games, Flowers & Plants (faux), Scented Candles and Home Fragrances. 'Coat Stands & Hooks' (13) was dropped as a mostly-functional roll-up (coat racks) and 'Chest of Drawers & Mirrors' (11) as a furniture roll-up. The site has no clocks category. 'Wall Decor' (12) is kept: its titles are wall decorations plus decorative wall shelves, both named in scope.
